# P21 fixed retrieval corpus

Revision: `p21-fixed-v1`. The vault is a byte-for-byte copy of the accepted bootstrap corpus plus `rust_identifiers.md`. Bootstrap files remain untouched. Eight labeled questions cover six classes. The paraphrase is held out; no vector or ranking tuning uses labels. All methods receive the same 6,000 byte / 1,000 estimated-token ceiling and k=10. Entity and relationship methods have graph relevance labels; document methods have document labels; hybrid evaluates their union. Metrics use exported context passage paths followed by assertion IDs in rendered output order, deduplicated and truncated to k=10. This makes target-specific Recall@k and nDCG informative within a target, without asserting scores across different targets are directly comparable.

Dense vectors use fixed hash-derived synthetic coordinates independent of relevance labels. They exercise exact cosine, isolated spaces, and fusion; they do not evaluate a semantic model. No quality thresholds, ranking-gain claims, real provider calls, or generated-answer evaluation occur. Supported-assertion precision measures source-backed context bundles, not model prose. Complete evidence-set recall measures the two independent forward supports, either through assertion citations or captured-source citations that cover each exact support span. Unanswerable/stale questions have no relevance positives; Recall/nDCG are null, with returned-count and leakage recorded separately.

The test emits an explicit artifact at `LWIKI_P21_EVIDENCE` or the system temporary directory's `lwiki-p21-retrieval-baseline.json`. Every method/query gets a fresh process and disposable vault copy with prebuilt cache; its first call is process-cold, its second call process-warm. OS page caches are not flushed. Peak RSS covers each child process including initialization and validation; disk is logical file bytes, not allocated blocks. Provider requests/tokens/spend are zero because cached vectors are seeded directly and no dispatcher exists. Local invariants separately exercise withdrawal and space replacement.
